mapper.sql: select special_date_id, tenant_id, dept_id, room_type_id, special_date, date_type, date_name, description, price_adjustment_type, adjustment_value, priority, status, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, del_flag from pms_special_date_pricing
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO pms_special_date_pricing ( tenant_id, dept_id, room_type_id, special_date, date_type, date_name, description, price_adjustment_type, adjustment_value, priority, status, create_by, create_time, del_flag ) VALUES
( #{item.tenantId}, #{item.deptId}, #{item.roomTypeId}, #{item.specialDate}, #{item.dateType}, #{item.dateName}, #{item.description}, #{item.priceAdjustmentType}, #{item.adjustmentValue}, #{item.priority}, #{item.status}, #{item.createBy}, #{item.createTime}, '0' )
mapper.select: SELECT date_type, COUNT(*) as count, AVG(adjustment_value) as avg_adjustment, MIN(special_date) as earliest_date, MAX(special_date) as latest_date FROM pms_special_date_pricing WHERE del_flag = '0' AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND dept_id = #{deptId} AND special_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY date_type ORDER BY count DESC
